sections.title: Conjugation of Poder (o → ue)
sections.content:
You know **poder** (can / to be able to) from Unit 10 (*puedo*, *puedes*): it changes *o → ue* like *querer*. Here you use it to ask for help and to say what you can do. It is followed directly by an infinitive verb:
- *puedo hablar*: I can speak
- *¿puedes venir?*: can you come?

items.spanish: Puedo hablar un poco de español.
items.english: I can speak a little Spanish.
Can you help me with the suitcases?

items.spanish: Hoy no podemos salir porque llueve mucho.
items.english: Today we cannot go out because it's raining heavily.
